reason: My wheels are scuffed and it bothers me, and £280 for a set that looks good in the photos is much less than new. I can see them in person and only pay on collection, so there's not much to lose by going to look.
objection: Refurbished paint might peel or the kerb repair might fail again after a few months, and with no reviews I've only got the seller's word for how they hold up.
would_change_my_mind: Proof the finish lasts, such as a stated lacquer or powder coat process, a written warranty on the finish, or photos of a set that has been on a car for a few months.
